contact.witnessConvention: p_geom0=pos-dist*n/2; p_geom1=pos+dist*n/2; margin=0; admitted face/convex domain only
contact.loadedDefinition: Fn>0 exactly; Fn=0 diagnostic; Fn<0 with adhesion0 UNKNOWN
contact.requiredSupport: positive outward aggregate; missing loaded contact UNKNOWN
contact.slipPoint: same native con.pos for both body velocities
contact.nativeMinimumFrictionSource: ac60 include/mujoco/mjmodel.h mjMINMU; collision driver effective contact friction padding

energyGrowth.interpretation: inherited physical acceptance floor, not float64 roundoff bound

stand.effectiveFormulaAlgebraBudget: gamma_12*(abs(kp*u)+abs(kp*thetaPre)+abs(kv*omegaPre)+abs(kv*omegaPost)+abs(nativeForce))+8*EPSILON*32; only validates algebra, never enlarges force cap

tip.uphillRimDefinition: project -downhill onto cylinder base plane, normalize, add r*direction to baseCenter, then dot with floor normal; degenerate pre-event UNKNOWN; post-event nullable diagnostic

tilt.window: N=100000/dtUs consecutive intervals; contact predicates at pre; last endpoint state-only; betaGrowth=lastEndpoint-firstPre; event at last endpoint
tilt.stageSpan: union previous accepted stable100ms and ALL current-stage pre/post angles through accepted stable window or firstConfirmed; freeze at event
tilt.event: firstConfirmed immutable; finish current FULL hold; no next target; remaining POST_EVENT_DIAGNOSTIC

A.initialization: authored native keyframe; one resetDataKeyframe before warning baseline

admission.parity: exact IEEE754 physical state plus pre-forward contact identity/force records every tick; split refresh versus full no-refresh
admission.refresh: split only: mj_kinematics,mj_comPos,mj_comVel after force capture; exact qpos/qvel/qacc/qacc_warmstart/time preservation

resources.temporaryOwnership: contact vector and each contact.get owned; warning vector borrowed, each warning.get owned; DoubleBuffer caller owned; all try/finally; created/deleted counters; not leak test

budgets.scope: one explicit invocation; all replays separately counted; no hidden probes

retention.numericEncoding: IEEE754 binary64 little endian, preserve -0, canonical NaN quiet payload 0x7ff8000000000000; finite guards still fail nonfinite
retention.strings: UTF8 length-prefixed U32LE; object keys sorted by UTF8 byte order
retention.recordFraming: tagged canonical binary payload; journal header then U32LE payload bytes per record
retention.perTick: canonical digest every actual tick; rolling SHA256 chain checkpointed at fixed100ms and world/failure end; every guard and cumulative integral computed before sparse retention
retention.eventWindow: immutable first event; post only within already scheduled full hold; no extra advance
retention.failureWindow: pre200ms plus failing tick; preserve prefix on resource error
retention.archive: draft release asset with byte-exact download/hash verification before publication; no public release/tag/Latest change
retention.emergencyReserveReason: two active admission worlds, each max200ms pre-window at24KiB/tick plus one <=256KiB partial failing observation, bounded framing, final64KiB trailer; normal writes stop before reserve; no extra native advance
retention.failureOversizePolicy: full partial observation remains in external attempt receipt; journal retains bounded native state/counts plus full observation digest if partial exceeds256KiB; failure remains FAIL
retention.rawErrors: portable fixed classification only; complete host-specific error strings in external receipt
retention.endpointDerivedState: endpointBodies is runtime-only; retained parity.endpoint stores all qpos/qvel/qacc/qacc_warmstart/time, and COM0/freejoint frame mapping is admitted and checked every split tick; no native state removed

rationale.nativeSteps: REQ-PHY-04 initial 2/4 native-step candidate changed before dynamics to 10/20 under 5ms macro; inherited admitted MuJoCo PHY01 dt500/250us, new contact qualification results do not transfer.
rationale.qualification: native explicit CLI is sole physics gate; default Vitest is pure/static only; future isolated GitHub qualification CI must execute exact same CLI
limitations: no normal-direction accuracy claim from CCD tolerance
no full supply-chain or binary reproducibility claim
